polarity: A NEW APPOINTMENT into a sustainability or ESG leadership role is a DEAD LEAD, not a lead — the mandate is filled and the fee is gone. Return it ONLY if it created a backfill vacancy, or the source states further hiring or team build-out.
A DEPARTURE WITH NO NAMED SUCCESSOR is the strongest lead in this system — an open seat with a live search need and a decision-maker under pressure to fill it.

An INTERNAL PROMOTION is a lead for the role the promotee VACATED, never for the role they filled. Read the promotee's PREVIOUS title: that seat is now open, is usually not yet advertised, and nobody else is searching for it.

A JOB POSTING THAT NAMES A RECRUITMENT AGENCY OR SEARCH FIRM IS A DEAD LEAD — the mandate already belongs to a competitor. A senior role posted directly by the employer with no agency named is an un-mandated live search and scores high.

A RESTRUCTURE, LAYOFF OR TITLE ELIMINATION in a sustainability function is a lead on a 6-12 month horizon, not a negative — the function rebuilds, and the firm that was talking to them before the rebuild wins it.

HIRING MUST BE STATED, NEVER INFERRED. "This company has grown and probably needs a sustainability lead" is not a signal. If you are deducing a hiring need rather than reading one, there is no signal.

A MEGA-CAP IS A WEAK PROSPECT EVEN ON A REAL SIGNAL — FTSE 100 majors, global oil and gas, the Big Four and global banks have mature functions, in-house talent teams and incumbent search agreements. They qualify on a departure or a restructure and almost never on general activity.

areas.description: Interim and contract cover. Count it when a seat is vacant NOW with no successor named, when a reporting deadline falls before a permanent hire could realistically start, or when a restructure has removed capacity a company still needs.

Count it when an organisation is building or rebuilding a function rather than filling one seat — a new division, a post-restructure rebuild, or a first-time compliance scope change.

## This Week's Headline
European Bank for Reconstruction and Development selected Cognizant as strategic partner for a five-year technology transformation framework spanning artificial intelligence, data analytics and software engineering.

## Closing Soon
**2026-11-11** — East Riding of Yorkshire Council — East Riding of Yorkshire Council published a tender: Network Operating System (Cisco), valued at GBP 275,000, closing 2026-11-11. [source](https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/Notice/ocds-h6vhtk-077fdf)

(unconfirmed) [source](https://shattered.io/cognizant-ebrd-five-year-ai-tech-blueprint-2026)

(unconfirmed) [source](https://www.googlecloudpresscorner.com/2026-10-08-Zip-US-Collaborates-with-Google-Cloud-to-Build-AI-Native-Product-Factory-with-Gemini-Enterprise)
- DHS plans a $100M follow-on contract for data engineering services from 2026-10-29, opening data_analytics; Counter-reading: DHS may use existing contract vehicles or incumbent providers for the follow-on. [source](https://www.govconwire.com/articles/dhs-data-engineering-services-contract)

[source](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/8x8-accelerates-product-innovation-appointment-130000475.html)
- DOW appoints Jon Steinbach as Strategic Technical Adviser to the CIO on 2026-10-19, opening tech_strategy; Counter-reading: the role is advisory; DOW may not have a funded transformation programme yet. No signals this week.

- North East Combined Authority's AI Growth Zone tender (Open Tenders) and HM Land Registry's Consult AI tool adoption (Movement) both signal public sector demand for AI implementation support, though via different routes — one a formal tender, the other an internal tool deployment.
- European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (Primary) and Zip US (Primary) both open multi-service conversations spanning artificial_intelligence and software_engineering, indicating buyer appetite for integrated AI-product delivery.
- DHS's $100M data engineering follow-on (Primary) and EBRD's data_analytics opening (Primary) together show sustained data-foundation investment across regulated and development-finance buyers.

1. Prepare an independent assurance proposal for the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development's five-year transformation framework, targeting the oversight gap left by Cognizant's prime partner role. (tied to EBRD signal)
2. Submit a bid for the North East Combined Authority AI Growth Zone Programme Delivery tender before the 2026-10-29 publication window closes. (tied to NECA tender)

polarity: AN OFFICE OPENING, HEADQUARTERS MOVE OR NEW MARKET ENTRY in a city we serve is the strongest LEAD there is — staff need accommodation from week one, and the booking habit sets within about six weeks. Speed matters more than size.

A COMPANY CONSOLIDATING OR EXITING A MARKET cuts both ways and the direction decides everything: consolidating INTO cities we serve is a LEAD, because travel between those cities increases. Exiting a city we serve is a DEAD LEAD on that city, however large the company.
A FUNDING ROUND OR ANNOUNCED HEADCOUNT GROWTH is a LEAD — more staff in more places means more nights, and a freshly funded company has not yet signed an accommodation agreement with anyone.

A HOTEL OR RESIDENTIAL ASSET COMING TO MARKET, a developer announcing a scheme, or an operator handing back a building is a LEAD for the real estate stream, not the corporate one. Different buyer, different conversation, often a longer deal.
A COMPETITOR OPENING IN A CITY WE SERVE is a DEFENSIVE signal — flag it against the accounts in that city rather than treating it as an opportunity.
AN ORGANISATION WITH NO PRESENCE IN ANY CITY WE SERVE IS NOT A PROSPECT, however well the event reads. Geography is part of the fit here, not a filter applied afterwards.
A MERGER OR ACQUISITION is a LEAD on two streams at once — integration means people travelling between two sets of offices for months, and it usually means offsites.

polarity: A NEW SUSTAINABILITY, CLIMATE OR POLICY LEAD APPOINTED at a company or public body is a LEAD — not as a buyer, but as a decision-maker to brief. There is roughly a ninety-day window before their position on policy hardens, and that window is the whole opportunity.

A GOVERNMENT CONSULTATION OPENING is one of the strongest leads in this system, because it has a published closing date and a response is expected. State the deadline. It is the only thing here that genuinely expires.
A COMPANY PUBLISHING A NET-ZERO, NATURE OR TRANSITION COMMITMENT is a LEAD — a public commitment needs policy credibility behind it, and the organisation now has something to defend.

A COMPANY WEAKENING OR ABANDONING A CLIMATE TARGET is ALSO a LEAD, and a different kind. It is an advocacy target rather than a partnership prospect, so flag it as such and do not score it as a funding opportunity.

A FOUNDATION OR FUNDER ANNOUNCING A GRANT PROGRAMME, strategy or call is a LEAD on the funding side rather than the influence side. These are the rows that actually pay for the work, and they carry hard deadlines.
A COALITION, ALLIANCE OR TASKFORCE FORMING is a LEAD — the question is whether to join it, convene it or brief it, and being early is the whole advantage.

AN ENFORCEMENT ACTION OR PROSECUTION against a company in a policy area we work in is a LEAD on the SECTOR, not usually on the defendant. The other companies in that sector are the ones who now need to demonstrate credibility.
A REGULATOR OR GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENT IS NOT ITSELF A FUNDER OR A PARTNER in most cases. It is the author of the obligation. The lead is whoever the decision obliges.

polarity: A GREENWASHING RULING, CHALLENGE OR INVESTIGATION against a named organisation is the STRONGEST LEAD in this system. The organisation needs a credible narrative immediately and has no time to run a procurement. Speed is the entire advantage.
A NET-ZERO, NATURE OR SOCIAL COMMITMENT ANNOUNCED is a LEAD — a commitment nobody has heard of does nothing for the company that made it, and making it land is exactly what this business sells.
A NEW CSO OR CMO IN POST is a LEAD — a new leader arrives wanting a visible early win, and an agency relationship is one of the fastest they can commission.

A MANDATORY REPORTING REGIME COMING INTO FORCE is a LEAD on every organisation it newly captures, and NOT on the regulator that wrote it. First-time reporters are the best prospects, because they have no incumbent designer.
B CORP CERTIFICATION, AN AWARD WIN OR A RATINGS UPGRADE is a LEAD — the organisation has something it wants to talk about and a reason to spend on saying it well.

A COMPANY QUIETLY DROPPING A TARGET is a WEAK LEAD at best. It signals retreat from spending on this agenda, not appetite for it — score it low and say why, rather than treating any sustainability news as an opportunity.
AN ORGANISATION WITH NO PUBLIC ENVIRONMENTAL POSITION AT ALL IS NOT A PROSPECT. This business sells help with a story; a company that has not started telling one has nothing to brief on yet.
